proposal.summary: Exploit for Source Engine (CS:GO and others) BuildIDs allows arbitrary code execution by writing a crafted payload to /tmp/hl2_relaunch and invoking a shell command on macOS (posix).
proposal.affected_product: Source Engine (CS:GO BuildID: 4937372, TF2 BuildID: 4871679, Garry's Mod BuildID: 4803834, Half Life 2 BuildID: 4233302)

PR.quote:
if os.name == "posix":
    command = str(input("Code to run? "))

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the original vulnerability report or vendor advisory describing how the payload is delivered and how the engine invokes /tmp/hl2_relaunch; reproduce on a test system and identify the vulnerable code path to create a patch or mitigation.

The script requests attacker-supplied command input
